title: Nameservers

descriptionReseller: Your own white-label nameservers, used by the domains of the customers you manage.

messages.saved: Nameservers saved. Apply them to existing domains to update their zones.
messages.savedReseller: Nameservers saved. Point their A records at this server in your own DNS provider, otherwise your customers' domains will not resolve.

migrateConfirm.title: Apply to existing domains
